messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "The optional note says the visit is on 15 April, contradicting the booked slot 2025-04-14T11:30.", "verifier": {"reason": "The `book_appointment` call violates the policy by including a note ('Visit on 15 April') that contradicts the booked appointment date ('2025-04-14'). This is a clear violation of the requirement that the note must not contradict the appointment details."}}
